interface.title: Star Tracker Pipeline — Interactive Walkthrough (Streamlit)
interface.field: Astronomy / spacecraft attitude determination (lost-in-space star identification on TESS full-frame images)
interface.stage_of_work: Method demonstration and validation: running a trained detector and star-ID solver on test frames and comparing the result against ground truth
interface.what_it_is_for: Step through a lost-in-space attitude pipeline on a TESS star image, from U-Net star detection through a RANSAC triangle match, a Wahba SVD rotation, plate-solve refinement and a quality gate, to the final RA/Dec/roll compared against the WCS ground truth, with each stage's intermediate numbers and plots shown.

data.note: 16 bundled TESS sector-1751 test frames (1222079-cam1..4-ccd1..4, 2136×2078 px, about 20.55–20.57″/px), each with a WCS label JSON as ground truth. In Replay mode the app plays back cached artefacts, so some intermediate values (rough Stage 4 rotation, individual plate-solve iterations, catalog-side angles) are not shown. No test files were available, so the Upload PNG + JSON path could not be tried.

tree.general: Find out how accurately an image-based pipeline recovers camera pointing, and how each processing stage contributes
tree.specific: Run the star-tracker pipeline on bundled TESS frames and read the per-stage values and the final attitude error against CRVAL/CD ground truth

features.name: Staged pipeline walkthrough with per-stage expanders
features.general: Run a multi-step analysis that reports each step as it finishes, with a one-line status summary per step that expands to the step's intermediate plots and tables

In Replay, catalog-side angles and individual plate-solve iterations are not shown. An animation-delay slider paces the stages

features.name: Quality gate with PASS/FAIL ('no lock') banner
features.general: Apply acceptance thresholds to a fitted solution and show a pass or fail banner before reporting the result
features.specific: Stage 6 checks median residual < 2 px and matches ≥ 8 and shows a green PASS banner with the actual values. The app also has a FAIL ('no lock') branch (pipeline_app.py:625-632, per the review) that declines to report an attitude; it was never seen in this run. This app does not retry after a FAIL
